verdict.rationale: Notte clearly supports live session viewing via ViewerUrl and 'Live View & Replays / Screenshare & session playback', and sessions expose a CDP endpoint connectable via Playwright, which could technically allow intervention. However, there is no explicit documentation of a human-takeover/handoff mechanism to pause the agent and manually control the browser mid-run. Missing for 10: explicit takeover/pause-and-control workflow, documentation of how control passes from agent to human and back, and independent confirmation this works in practice.
